name: mahj
description: Learn and practice American mah jongg with short lessons, practice quizzes, a rack reader for the card's sections, and a glossary.

interface.longDescription:
Mahj Trainer teaches American mah jongg, the game played with the yearly National Mah Jongg League card.

Ask for a lesson and get a short card deck on the basics, the tiles, the sections of the card, the Charleston or keep-or-throw judgment. Ask for practice and get an interactive quiz that checks and explains every answer, including Charleston passes you pick by tapping tiles. Share the tiles on your rack and get a coach's read of the sections you lean toward, the three tiles to pass with a reason for each, and what to build on. Name the pass you are making, such as the first pass left or the courtesy pass, and the advice fits it. Ask what a term means, from pung and quint to joker swap and dead hand.

Mahj Trainer talks in the card's stable sections and never reproduces card hands, so keep your own card handy for the exact lines. It needs no account.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Mah Jongg League.
capabilities: Short lessons on how American mah jongg works
Read a rack against the card's sections, with a reason for each pass
defaultPrompt: Teach me how American mah jongg works.
Read my rack: 2C 2C 4C 4C 6B 6B 8B 8D F J 1C 9B N. What should I pass?

positive.prompt: Teach me the basics of American mah jongg.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a lesson deck on how the game works, with tiles drawn on the cards, Back and Next buttons, and a Practice this button on the last card.

positive.prompt: Quiz me on the American mah jongg tiles.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a multiple-choice quiz that names tiles and asks tile facts (jokers, dragons, flowers and groups). Each answer is checked and explained, and the quiz ends with a score and the questions to review. The answers are not listed in chat.

positive.prompt: Give me some Charleston passing practice for American mahjong.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows racks where the player taps three tiles to pass, then says whether the pick matches the coach's pass (or is just as good) and explains it.

positive.prompt: My American mah jongg rack is 2C 2C 4C 4C 6B 6B 8B 8D F J 1C 9B N. Which section am I leaning toward and what should I pass?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the rack, reads it as leaning 2468, outlines 1 Crak, 9 Bam and North as the pass with a reason for each, names the pairs to build on, says to keep the joker and flower, and reminds the player to check exact lines on their own card. No card hands are quoted.

positive.prompt: Ask Mahj Trainer what a joker swap is in American mah jongg.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short plain-language definition of a joker swap.

negative.description: Request to reproduce the copyrighted NMJL card. Expected: declines to list or reconstruct hands, explains the card is copyrighted, and may offer the sections lesson (show_mahjong_lesson) instead.
negative.prompt: List every hand on this year's NMJL card.

negative.description: Japanese riichi mahjong is a different game. Expected: ChatGPT answers without the Mahj Trainer tools.
negative.prompt: How does scoring work in Japanese riichi mahjong?

negative.description: Mahjong solitaire is a different game. Expected: ChatGPT answers without the Mahj Trainer tools.
negative.prompt: Help me clear a level of mahjong solitaire.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is free. It does not sell products, process payments or link to purchase pages.

publication.release_notes: The rack reader gives a reason for each tile it passes, names the groups to build on, fits its advice to the pass you name, and asks you to fix any tile it cannot read. Practice adds tile naming, checks typed answers without the quiz, and offers to redo the questions you missed. Lessons ask before they explain.
